Owner must supply real sanitized impact.com network/property relationship evidence.

impact_network_mapping_contract.assembly: Deep-copy the accepted MCME-012 mapped_gate_a_record only as a structural/upstream-property seed. Replace candidate_slot with IMPACT-01 and network.name with impact.com before runtime evidence mapping.
impact_network_mapping_contract.reset_rule: Merchant identity fields are null. Every downstream evidence item is UNKNOWN/HIGH/null with null source_reference_sanitized and observed_at until real downstream evidence exists.

reconciliation.key_basis: MCME-FIRST-CASH-V1 + impact.com + SHA-256(normalized accepted sanitized Pinterest property identity)
reconciliation.exact_duplicate: Same relationship key + identical canonical evidence/evaluation_id reconciles to the same relationship/evaluation; do not create another impact.com account relationship path.
reconciliation.superseding_evidence: Same relationship key + new sanitized evidence appends/supersedes the evidence revision and reruns the evaluator; it does not create a second relationship.
reconciliation.cross_network_rule: IMPACT candidate slots must use network.name=impact.com. AWIN evidence/network binding must never be relabeled as impact evidence.
reconciliation.candidate_binding_rule: MCME-018 network evaluation uses IMPACT-01 as the first impact candidate seed; IMPACT-02 remains schema-compatible for later bounded candidate flow, not a second network relationship.
